body:
Independent QA: **evidence-incomplete**. The full 63-file master-to-head review found no new blocking code defect; the directory-lock fix, real PostgreSQL execution and two genuine browser pairs were verified. Independent checks passed: 133 component/backend/API tests and 4 browser scenarios.

Remaining gates: actual native chooser Before/After proof is unavailable, and PR439 has no recorded current-head configured engineering review or applicable quota refusal. Browser/component checks do not replace native evidence. The coordinator should arrange those gates and return affected evidence to QA.

[Immutable assessment, exact revisions, findings and evidence](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/e83d376cfb37b4927ed21bae39eb6f6453fca509/pr439-qa/verdict.json). PR402 and staged PR431/437 are unchanged; no readiness or merge action was taken.
